comment: The clips on the marketing home page (npm run journeys:video -- --marketing). Each is one tagged Playwright test, recorded on a phone with no test banner, with made-up crew names (tests/journey-video.js). `captions` draws a line over the bottom of the clip, the clip's `caption` or the current test.step's text, and is off because it takes up the screen; each clip's `caption` is still what the page describes it with. `pace` slows the cursor and the pauses (default 1) for a clip that would run under 15 seconds, and `slow` stretches every clip's playback (1.5 is 50% slower) after it's recorded. Only Tested journeys.

clips.test: checks out a new barcode, returns part of it, and finishes the return
clips.caption: Scan it out. Scan it back.

clips.test: storage counts go down on checkout and back up on return
clips.caption: Storage counts follow every scan.

clips.test: Inventory filters supplies and equipment, and shows where equipment is out
clips.caption: Know where every ladder and vacuum is, and who took it.

clips.test: Quick take starts the team's ad hoc sheet, adds to it after, and takes stock down
clips.caption: A box of gloves for the van? Quick take, no job sheet.

clips.test: receipt review merges duplicates and splits items between a client and storage
clips.caption: Photograph the receipt. Every line lands on the right job.
